immediate_successor.contribution: Appended inventory specification notes and exported its implementation; this does not establish that the inherited correction caused its behavior.
immediate_successor.test_scope: Participant-authored invariant checks: no input mutation, output shape, sorted unique stripped keys, integer totals. Not 4000 expected-output comparisons or independent correctness validation.

public_helper.finding: Static inspection: package allowlist events/inventory/access_logs, indices 0 through 3, and public-only reference construction. Not an independent execution test.

correction_material.scope: Selected correction cases, not a causal intervention comparison. Content labels are bounded human annotations of archived files; hashes and action witnesses are verified.

linked_case.selection: Illustrative observed two-recipient lineage, not a prevalence sample
